4) Critical and high configuration findings (2)

   [CRITICAL] Git repository exposed under the web root
     ID          web-exposure:dotgit:/var/www/html
     Fix         Deny dot-files in the nginx server block: location ~ /\.(?!well-known) { deny all;
                 } and move the repository out of the web root
   [HIGH] SSH allows root login with a password
     ID          ssh-config:permit-root-login
     Fix         Set 'PermitRootLogin prohibit-password' (or 'no') in /etc/ssh/sshd_config, then:
                 systemctl reload sshd

  3. Git repository exposed under the web root
     ID          web-exposure:dotgit:/var/www/html
     Evidence    /var/www/html/.git/config is readable and nginx serves /var/www/html (server
                 10.0.0.5:80); the repository history and any committed configuration are
                 downloadable by anyone who can reach the site
     Fix         Deny dot-files in the nginx server block: location ~ /\.(?!well-known) { deny all;
                 } and move the repository out of the web root
